verdict.rationale: New Relic has a dedicated OpenTelemetry integration path documented explicitly: 'Instrument your service with OpenTelemetry and gain platform-agnostic observability' and 'By integrating OpenTelemetry with New Relic, you can leverage a wide range of platform capabilities to analyze the data and diagnose problems,' confirming native OTLP ingestion and first-class OTel support. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of OTLP endpoint reliability or performance, and more detail on OTLP-specific configuration (endpoints, auth headers) beyond high-level docs.
